name: rlynjb-aipe
description: Spec workflow plugin for AI-assisted development

plugins.name: aipe
plugins.description: Generate filled specs from 29 disciplined templates across two flows — action (Describe → Diagnose → Act) and reflective (Evaluate, Teach + Rehearse + Read). Study family covers 15 CS/AI topics (system design, software design, data modeling, security, testing, runtime, networking, databases, DSA, distributed systems, observability, performance, AI eng, prompt eng, agent architecture); rehearse family covers 4 human-layer artifacts (problem selection, design docs, demo, interview defense). Two orchestrators run their families in one pass. Uses your agent's own model, no external CLI.
